notes:
- New: automatic daily data updates (Gold) - ticked universes stay current at 1 minute: after login and after each market close; missing days in the last 30 days filled; Stop button in the status bar
- New: chart backgrounds Light / Black / Midnight; grid lines removed, session lines kept
- New: Help > Upgrade to Gold / Platinum - plan, 1/3/12 months and referral code in one request
- New: Help > My Referral Code - copy your code or a ready-made share message
